title: Weighted Shortest Path
prompt:
**Tình huống.** A directed graph with n ≤ 100000 vertices, m ≤ 200000 edges, positive integer weights. For one source s, print the shortest distance to every vertex.

**Thuật toán nào phù hợp nhất? Chương trình chỉ cần in ra chữ cái.**

**A)** BFS from s

**B)** Kruskal minimum spanning tree

**C)** Dijkstra with a priority queue

**D)** DSU with path compression

tests.name: answer
tests.hint: Weights are positive and arbitrary — BFS only works on unit weights; Dijkstra with a heap is the fit.
